    (package private) void
    map_whenDurationIsNotPositive_returnsZero()
    Checks that a sequence without a positive duration (equal timestamps or a single item) gives a zero score, so that it never outranks a sequence that can be integrated.

    Checks that a sequence with an empty list of items gives a zero score.
